At Blue Pictures, our vision is to bring all movies a n d all genres from every territory to the burgeoning African and global markets. More About Distribution Bluepictures Cinema Movies Now Showing Action, Nollywood / 4:20pm & 6:20pm Isakaba Return Get Ticket Action, Nollywood / 4:20pm The Beacon Man Get Ticket Action, Nollywood / 2:30pm Loving Itohan Get Ticket Action, Nollywood / 12:00pm Wire Transfer Get Ticket Action, Nollywood / 12:40pm Maybe… Maybe Not Get Ticket Action, Nollywood / 2:10pm The Cleaner Get Ticket Coming Soon More Movies Coming Soon Recognition Award Best Lagos Island Movie Centre We are delighted to share the exciting news that BluePictures Cinema has been honored as the Best Movie Center on Lagos Island in the esteemed Lagos Island Talent Awards 2024 edition! This prestigious accolade reflects our unwavering dedication to providing exceptional cinematic experiences to our valued patrons. From the latest blockbusters to timeless classics, we take pride in curating a diverse selection of films that cater to every taste and preference. This recognition serves as a testament to the hard work and commitment of our team, as well as the continuous support from our loyal customers and the vibrant Lagos Island community.
